data.narrative:
Mbodi AI is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Xavier Chi and Sebastian Peralta that has raised $4.4M to date. The comparable universe consists of 9 private companies and 1 public company operating in the robotics and manufacturing sector, including peers such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics.

Due to insufficient narrowly-filtered peer data—only one same-stage comparable was identified across the Robotics & Manufacturing space—a peer-median valuation method was not applicable. Instead, a stage-progression approach was employed, applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $4.4M total raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $11M.

The triangulation analysis, constrained to a single applicable methodology, supports a valuation range of $9M to $13M, with a median of $11M. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific company and sector, the limited peer visibility at the Seed stage in frontier robotics, and whether total capital raised adequately reflects future-stage expectations. Additional clarity on revenue, unit economics, or technical differentiation would strengthen confidence in this range.
